source: Provincial Department of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries, Pursat Province — សារធាតុចិញ្ចឹមសម្រាប់ដំណាំស្រូវ (Nutrients for the Rice Crop), presenter Yem Sophy, 20 Nov 2017, p.3
text: Fertilizer types (ប្រភេទជី) fall into two broad categories: (1) ជីសរីរាង្គ organic fertilizer, further divided into natural/traditional organic fertilizer and organic fertilizer produced with improved technology; and (2) ជីអសរីរាង្គ inorganic (chemical) fertilizer, further divided into single-nutrient fertilizer (ជីទោល) and compound/mixed fertilizer (ជីសមាស). This slide indicates the two categories are to be covered in turn.

source: Provincial Department of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries, Pursat Province — សារធាតុចិញ្ចឹមសម្រាប់ដំណាំស្រូវ (Nutrients for the Rice Crop), presenter Yem Sophy, 20 Nov 2017, p.3 & p.6-26
text: Clarification: although the classification slide (p.3) simply lists organic and inorganic/chemical fertilizer as the two categories to be discussed, this deck does NOT skip inorganic fertilizer — the majority of the presentation (pages 6 through 26) is in fact a detailed treatment of inorganic/chemical fertilizer, covering specific single-nutrient and compound NPK products, nutrient roles and deficiency symptoms, application methods, and application rates/timing. Organic fertilizer is covered more briefly (pages 4-5).
